scope: Explicit SMB per-user/space ownership authority; complete backup/restore privilege and Full SMB/NFS remain open.

checks: admin-only scoped ownership assignment; take overrides denied WRITE_OWNER and MAXIMUM_ALLOWED only, allows self ownership and denies arbitrary SIDs
restore accepts valid arbitrary owner/group SIDs atomically and overrides WRITE_OWNER only with backup intent; it cannot bypass data/WRITE_DAC/SACL rights, readonly shares or its configured space
SecD restores initial owner/group and resolves inherited CREATOR OWNER/GROUP against those identities, with or without an explicit DACL
authority revocation drains old privileged handles; fresh ordinary handles cannot restore, and explicitly restored authority persists across service restart
SMB2.1/3.0/3.0.2/3.1.1 repeated signed/encrypted NTLM renewal preserves session ID, keys, opens and byte-range locks
expired authority reports NETWORK_SESSION_EXPIRED and renews the same open after an intervening management login
wrong proof and different-user renewal fail, remove old session authority and release exclusive handles before the error reply
fresh valid credentials cannot renew a revoked token or resurrect its exclusive open
LOGOFF during an incomplete renewal resets authentication state and permits a fresh encrypted session on the same transport
SESSION_SETUP for an unknown session does not abort another session's in-progress renewal or borrow its signing key
schema 5 migration backs up each file authority before adding persistent security descriptors
self-relative owner/group/DACL query, requested sections, required buffer size and READ_CONTROL/WRITE_DAC/SACL boundaries
ordered deny/allow access checks, MAXIMUM_ALLOWED and explicit-right intersection; existing handles retain granted rights
SMB denial enforced by NFSv3 READ/ACCESS, NFSv4 ACCESS, core API and WebDAV readonly aliases
ACE order, empty versus NULL DACL, implicit owner rights and OWNER RIGHTS SID
malformed offsets, overlaps, truncation and unsupported ACEs rejected atomically; ownership cannot be assigned to another user
file/directory inheritance with CREATOR OWNER substitution and multi-generation propagation; ACL follows rename
SecD CREATE persists protected initial ACL, validates ownership and rejects duplicate/malformed contexts before mutation
group ACE enforcement and membership revocation use freshly signed identity grants
schema 6 durability across process restart; replacement object receives fresh owner and ACL
NFS writer publication still enforces file DACL; WRITE and chmod cannot bypass SMB restrictions
DAV writer cannot bypass ACL; staged PUT retains restrictions, recursive COPY checks descendants and inherits destination ACL through private staging parents
DAV LOCK on unmapped URL checks parent create rights and persists inherited DACL
